## Delivery closure
- [ ] Resumed/audited existing source branch, worktrees, prior PRs and canonical implementation
- [ ] No duplicate registry/runtime, unrelated changes, hidden app dependency or discarded user assets
- [ ] Tests and denial/recovery evidence attached; user-visible journey exercised
- [ ] Reviewed and merged to main (when authorized), without equating merge with deployment
- [ ] Live install/host verified **or** incomplete delivery explicitly tracked without closing its issue
- [ ] Clean merged branches/worktrees safely pruned; unmerged work preserved and reported

See `docs/standards/DELIVERY_CLOSURE.md`. This PR template is not a release receipt.
